description: Consumer-aware compression for embedding indexes and LLM KV caches — compress by the metric the downstream consumer actually uses. PCA-Matryoshka + TurboQuant (27x @ 99.8% recall@10), asymmetric K/V, CUDA/Triton kernels, vLLM plugin, replayable CI-gated claims. MIT.
